name: Street Custom 'Panic Room' Deployable Safe Space
product_name: Street Custom 'Panic Room' Deployable Safe Space
description: A kit for rapidly converting a standard room into a defensible safe space — including door reinforcement bars, window blocking panels, a white noise generator for acoustic privacy, a Faraday mesh curtain for electronic isolation, and emergency supplies for 48 hours. The Panic Room kit allows anyone to turn a bedroom, office, or closet into a temporary refuge that resists forced entry, blocks surveillance, and sustains the occupant through a crisis. The kit has become standard household equipment in Tier 1 and 2 where personal security is not guaranteed by any authority.

specifications.info: resists 500 kg force; standard sizes; 3-meter radius; full room coverage; water; first aid

story_hooks: A family in Tier 1 survived a 36-hour siege inside a Panic Room deployment — the door reinforcement held against repeated breaching attempts, and the Faraday mesh prevented the attackers from tracking the family's devices.

Panic Room kits are being sold with a hidden tracking device that reports the deployment location — someone is building a map of every safe room in the lower tiers, which is also a map of people who feel unsafe.

physical_description.visual_profile: Heavy-duty tactical duffel bag with industrial webbing and reinforced stitching. Compact, modular kit that unfolds into multiple rigid components: steel door bars, translucent polymer window panels, mesh curtain rolls, and smaller accessory modules. Designed for rapid deployment rather than aesthetics.
physical_description.dimensions: Duffel bag form: 65cm L × 35cm W × 30cm D when packed; door bars extend to standard doorframe widths (60-90cm); window panels scale to typical windows (up to 1.5m × 1.2m); Faraday curtain covers ~3-meter radius when deployed
physical_description.weight_description: 12 kg total — handheld with shoulder strap, manageable for one person but fatiguing over distance. Packed as single compact unit; components redistribute weight when deployed
physical_description.primary_material: Heavy-gauge canvas and nylon exterior; steel reinforcement bars (chrome-plated); ballistic-grade polycarbonate panels; conductive mesh (copper-threaded); aluminum frame components
physical_description.finish: Matte industrial gray canvas with black cordura reinforcement patches. Steel bars have brushed chrome finish with subtle wear patterns. Mesh has dull copper sheen. Polymer panels semi-translucent with faint holographic security holograms embedded
physical_description.color_scheme: Charcoal gray primary, matte black accents, brushed chrome metallic details, copper mesh undertones. Minimal branding — functional over stylish
physical_description.interface_elements: White noise generator: small 8cm cylindrical unit with simple toggle switch, LED power indicator (amber/green), 3.5mm audio jack. Emergency supply compartments have numbered tabs (1-4) for quick access. Door bar has mechanical locking pins (no electronics). Mesh curtain has adhesive contact strips and snap points
distinctive_features: Modular construction — each component can be deployed independently
Faraday mesh curtain with integrated thermal blocking (dull copper weave pattern visible when deployed)
Door bars with shock-absorption rubber end caps
Ballistic panels have subtle linear reinforcement ribs running horizontally
White noise generator has industrial minimalist design with no branding visible on front
Emergency supplies packed in color-coded soft cases (red first aid, blue nutrition, yellow water, gray tools)
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: Street Custom logo (angular 'SC' monogram) embossed on duffel bag tab. Small regulatory compliance label on corner listing GLMZ safety certifications and Faraday effectiveness rating. Serial number and manufacture date etched on door bar frame
physical_description.condition_typical: Well-maintained units show minor wear on canvas corners and reinforcement patches. Steel bars may have light surface oxidation from humidity. Mesh curtain may have slight creases from storage. Units in active use show scuff marks on polymer panels and wear on strap webbing from repeated deployment cycles
